current_detail: H1-R2.35 is the complete physical-layout acceptance candidate without starting KiCad. The onboard analog-video experiment and owner-soldered receiver bay are removed. The exact dual-RP GPIO0..47 electrical baseline remains the reviewed H1-R2.31 pin-map artifact. The exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 + ER-TPC035-6 option 5344, its 50-contact i8080-8 adapter, exact C3169104 connector, all 18 U219 bodies, NFC loop and external antenna swept volume are registered. Four-face, external, internal, antenna-edge and sandwich projections are regenerated from one coordinate model: 215 registered bodies, zero same-face collisions and 2.59 mm minimum opposing-face clearance against the 0.70 mm rule. H1 has no remaining physical blocker; only explicit user acceptance remains before the H1 status may become reviewed. Live FSUSB42MUX/C11355 routing, the service-VBUS detector/latch and the Pack/Safety powered-off-Ioff boundary are the three fail-closed preconditions for a future R2 H2 export. Purchasing, KiCad and fabrication remain unauthorized.

preorder_release.factory_role: deterministic fabrication, population, display mating and final assembly from released files

stages.exit: placement, routed parity, routed electrical/RF/mechanical re-analysis, production outputs and independent DFM/CPL review
